name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.28: a payment port that is merely dead is now refused, and serial wiring is AG-admin only. 8626020623 was set to /dev/ttyS4 today, which is the exact port that cost three days on 8626020716 - it has nothing on the other end, so the machine stops taking cards and nothing anywhere says so. The old guard only caught a port colliding with the machine's own bus, which a dead port never does. Both paths that can set it, the set_payment_port command and the machine settings endpoint, now also check the port against where Nayax is actually wired for that machine type: coil reads payment on ttyS3 (ttyS1 is motors), gravity on ttyS1 (ttyS3 is the weight bus). Machine type is read from BOTH the model string and the isKioskModel flag because they can disagree - a fridge registered before model support carries isKioskModel=false while its model still says coil, which is 8626020623 exactly, and trusting the model alone would have recommended the coil port for a gravity machine. When they disagree the refusal says so and names the model as the thing to fix. A deliberate non-standard port is still possible with acceptNonStandardPort: true. Separately paymentSerialPort, motorSerialPort and controlBoardAddress now require ag_admin in both paths: they decide which physical bus the app opens, and a wrong one strands a placed machine silently, which is not something the owning operator can diagnose. Display and behaviour settings stay open to operators. Cumulative over v6.27.1.
